Seija.zh: [[S:LimitedDamage]]：每次正邪的回合开始，重置 300 点伤害上限。 道具解放顺序 开战固定：[[S:SingleJiandaoSe]]。第一个随机池：[[S:ShendengSe]]、[[S:SihunYuSe]]、[[S:MadokaBowSe]]。 第一次 [[4]] 将 [[S:HolyGrailSe]]、[[S:QiannianShenqiSe]] 加入剩余随机池；第二次再加入 [[S:InfinityGemsSe]]、[[S:SakuraWandSe]]。已获得的道具移出池子，不重复抽取；第五次 [[4]] 固定获得 [[S:DragonBallSe]]。 一场战斗只会获得七件随机道具中的五件，加上剪刀与玻璃球。 九件道具 [[S:SingleJiandaoSe]]：每打出一张牌，主角受到 1/2/2 点效果伤害。 [[S:ShendengSe]]：所有敌人回合结束后施加 3 回合 [[S:Weak]]、[[S:Fragil]] 或 [[S:Vulnerable]]；三个种类打乱后轮流使用。 [[S:SihunYuSe]]：自身回合结束时，按下方敌人池吸引敌人。 [[S:MadokaBowSe]]：自身回合结束时加入两张随机状态牌，一张洗入抽牌堆、一张放进弃牌堆。道具少于三件时在 [[C:Xingguang]]、[[C:Yueguang]]、[[C:Riguang]]、[[C:Xuanguang]] 中随机；至少三件时用 [[C:Chunguang]] 替换星光。 [[S:HolyGrailSe]]：下回合开始时清除主角能够在战斗中丢失的展品；光耀和秘宝等受保护展品保留。 [[S:QiannianShenqiSe]]：每个玩家回合最多抽 10 张牌，开局抽牌也计入；加入 [[C:QiannianShenqiCard]]。打出该牌解除抽牌上限，但从本回合第 11 张起，每次抽牌失去 2 点生命。 [[S:InfinityGemsSe]]：接下来两次自身回合开始时，对手牌、抽牌堆、弃牌堆分别随机放逐一半卡牌，向下取整；不从永久牌库移除。玻璃球生效后停止。 [[S:SakuraWandSe]]：[[2]] 和 [[3]] 的整组攻击各执行两遍，分别成为 16 次、4 次攻击。 [[S:DragonBallSe]]：下回合开始时意图改为 [[5]]，之后持续如此；[[X:GanzhuYao]] 只能挡住当次，不能阻止之后继续实现愿望。 散发邪气的挂坠 · 召唤规则 按双敌人 → 单敌人 → 单敌人循环。双敌人检查前方两个指定位置，单敌人轮流检查后方两个位置；只填补对应空位。最多四个召唤物，空位被占也会推进轮次。 准备进入双敌人轮次且正邪已拥有至少四件道具时，永久切换强池并重置轮次。各池先打乱再顺序循环。 所有挂坠召唤物获得 [[S:Servant]]：场上只剩使魔时立刻消灭，不触发死亡效果。挂坠召唤的乌鸦没有闪避。 弱池 · 双敌人 • [[U:MaoyuBlack]] ×2。 • [[U:RavenWen3]] + [[U:RavenGuo3]]。 弱池 · 单敌人 [[U:WhiteFairy]]、[[U:DollBlue]]、[[U:Yaoshi]]、[[U:Scout]]。 强池 · 双敌人 • [[U:YinyangyuRed]] + [[U:YinyangyuBlue]]。 • [[U:Purifier]] ×2。 • [[U:ShenlingWhite]] + [[U:ShenlingPurple]]。 强池 · 单敌人 [[U:BlackFairy]]、[[U:Terminator]]、[[U:WaterGirl]]、[[U:LangTiangou]]、[[U:YaTiangou]]、[[U:SuwakoLimao]]。
Seija.en: [[S:LimitedDamage]] resets its 300-damage budget at the start of each Seija turn. Tool unlock order Starts with [[S:SingleJiandaoSe]]. Initial random pool: [[S:ShendengSe]], [[S:SihunYuSe]], [[S:MadokaBowSe]]. The first [[4]] adds [[S:HolyGrailSe]] and [[S:QiannianShenqiSe]]; the second adds [[S:InfinityGemsSe]] and [[S:SakuraWandSe]]. Acquired tools leave the pool. The fifth [[4]] always grants [[S:DragonBallSe]]. One battle acquires five of the seven random tools, plus scissors and the orb. Nine tools [[S:SingleJiandaoSe]]: 1/2/2 effect damage to the player per card played. [[S:ShendengSe]]: after all enemy turns, apply 3-turn [[S:Weak]], [[S:Fragil]] or [[S:Vulnerable]], in shuffled groups of three. [[S:SihunYuSe]]: summon from the pools below at own turn end. [[S:MadokaBowSe]]: add two random status cards at own turn end, one to draw and one to discard. Below three tools: [[C:Xingguang]], [[C:Yueguang]], [[C:Riguang]], [[C:Xuanguang]]. At three or more, replace Starlight with [[C:Chunguang]]. [[S:HolyGrailSe]]: at next own turn start, remove player exhibits that can be lost in battle; protected Shining exhibits and treasures remain. [[S:QiannianShenqiSe]]: limit draws to 10 per player turn, including opening draws; add [[C:QiannianShenqiCard]]. Playing it removes the cap, but each draw from the eleventh costs 2 life that turn. [[S:InfinityGemsSe]]: at the next two own turn starts, randomly exile half of hand, draw and discard separately, rounded down. Permanent deck is unchanged; stops when the orb takes effect. [[S:SakuraWandSe]]: repeat the entire [[2]] / [[3]] sequences twice: 16 / 4 hits. [[S:DragonBallSe]]: next own turn uses [[5]] and repeats thereafter. [[X:GanzhuYao]] can stop that occurrence, not later wishes. Pendant summons Repeat pair → single → single. Pairs check the two front slots individually; singles alternate two rear slots. Fill only the corresponding vacancies, up to four summons. Occupied slots still advance the cycle. At a pair step with at least four tools, switch permanently to the strong pools and restart the cycle. Each pool is shuffled, then cycled in order. All pendant summons gain [[S:Servant]]: when only Servants remain they die immediately, without death effects. Pendant ravens have no Dodge. Weak pairs • [[U:MaoyuBlack]] ×2. • [[U:RavenWen3]] + [[U:RavenGuo3]]. Weak singles [[U:WhiteFairy]], [[U:DollBlue]], [[U:Yaoshi]], [[U:Scout]]. Strong pairs • [[U:YinyangyuRed]] + [[U:YinyangyuBlue]]. • [[U:Purifier]] ×2. • [[U:ShenlingWhite]] + [[U:ShenlingPurple]]. Strong singles [[U:BlackFairy]], [[U:Terminator]], [[U:WaterGirl]], [[U:LangTiangou]], [[U:YaTiangou]], [[U:SuwakoLimao]].

Rin.zh: 怨灵召唤 开战持有红、绿、蓝怨灵球各一枚，初始召唤顺序随机。怨灵死亡后，归还对应颜色的球。 [[S:RinSummon]] 初始 3 层，每召唤一只怨灵消耗 1 层。每 {Count1} 个自身回合恢复 1 层，上限 3 层。 死亡弹幕与地狱灼热 怨灵被击败时，对主角发动一次死亡弹幕。[[2]] 或 [[3]] 引爆怨灵时，这次攻击的伤害翻倍。 每有一名敌人死亡，燐获得 {Power} 层 [[S:RinAura]]。之后召唤的怨灵，死亡弹幕伤害增加召唤时的灼热层数。 燐召唤的怨灵具有 [[S:Servant]]。燐死亡后，它们一同消失，不发动死亡弹幕。
Rin.en: Spirit summons Starts with one red, green and blue spirit orb. A spirit’s death returns its orb; summoning uses the colors in a shuffled order. [[S:RinSummon]] starts at 3, costs 1 per spirit and recovers 1 every {Count1} own turns, up to 3. Death attacks and Hellfire Defeating a spirit triggers one attack on the player. Detonation by [[2]] or [[3]] doubles that attack’s damage. Each enemy death gives Rin {Power} [[S:RinAura]]. Newly summoned spirits add its level at spawn to their death-attack damage. Rin’s spirits have [[S:Servant]] and disappear without attacking when Rin dies.

GuihuoRed.en: Rin’s summoned spirits Spirits summoned by [[U:Rin]] have no timed self-explosion. Their death attack gains damage equal to [[S:RinAura]] at the time of summoning. Defeating them triggers a death attack; Rin’s detonation doubles it. When Rin dies, her summons disappear without a death attack.

Clownpiece.zh: 妖精大暴走 · 召唤阵型 N/H 第一次：[[U:BlackFairy]] ×1 + [[U:WhiteFairy]] ×2。 第二次：黑蝴蝶 ×2 + 向日葵妖精 ×1。 第三次及以后：黑蝴蝶 ×3。 L 难度从第二种阵型开始，然后直接进入三只黑蝴蝶。 已占据位置的妖精会恢复至满生命，不被替换；空位按当前阵型填补。新召唤妖精拥有 [[S:Servant]] 并在出现时获得 [[S:Lunatic]]。 [[S:LunaticTorch]] 的效果是每个玩家回合开始获得 1 点彩色法力。
Clownpiece.en: Fairy Rampage formations N/H first: 1 [[U:BlackFairy]] + 2 [[U:WhiteFairy]]. Second: 2 Black Butterflies + 1 Sunflower Fairy. Third onward: 3 Black Butterflies. L starts with the second formation, then three Black Butterflies. Existing fairies heal to full rather than being replaced. Empty slots use the current formation. New summons have [[S:Servant]] and receive [[S:Lunatic]] on spawn. [[S:LunaticTorch]] gives the player 1 rainbow mana at each player-turn start.

Kokoro.zh: 喜 · 面具召唤 [[0]] 首次召唤 [[U:MaskBlue]]；之后在 [[U:MaskRed]]、[[U:MaskGreen]]、[[U:MaskBlue]] 中随机，排除上一次颜色。最多三张面具，只填空位。 面具具有 [[S:Servant]]。 情绪与暗黑能量 喜、怒、忧、认真会替换上一个情绪状态。怒使全体敌人增加 {Power} 点火力；忧使主角获得 {Power} 回合虚弱并给自己格挡。 主角每次被施加一种负面状态，暗黑能量计数增加 1。[[3,4]] 先执行精准攻击，再执行“计数 × {Count1}”的独立效果伤害，随后计数归零。
Kokoro.en: Joy · Mask summons The first [[0]] summons [[U:MaskBlue]]. Later choose [[U:MaskRed]], [[U:MaskGreen]] or [[U:MaskBlue]], excluding the previous color. Up to three masks, filling vacancies only. Masks have [[S:Servant]]. Emotions and Dark Power Joy, Anger, Sorrow and Serious replace the previous emotion. Anger gives all enemies {Power} Firepower; Sorrow applies {Power}-turn Weak and grants Block. Each negative status applied to the player increases Dark Power by 1. [[3,4]] attacks accurately, then deals separate count × {Count1} effect damage and resets the count.

Doremy.zh: 睡眠与觉醒 睡眠护盾为 [[S:Sleep]] 的等级（{Count2}），每次自身回合结束补足；每次 [[0]] 增加 50 当前生命和最大生命、1 级梦境。 受到实际伤害可提前醒，[[X:HeiseBijiben]] 与 [[J:QuickAct1]] 不触发该判定。醒来清除睡眠护盾。 清醒后的防御每次往手牌加入 1 张 [[C:Nightmare]]；攻击则在梦境至少 1 级时加入。至少 2 级时增强伤害与护盾。自然睡满三次时立即进入[[S:DreamMaster]] 阶段。 [[S:DreamMaster]] · 梦境敌人 [[U:DreamRemilia]]、[[U:DreamAya]]、[[U:DreamJunko]]、[[U:DreamYoumu]] 每四次召唤重新打乱，组内不重复；在攻击或防御后轮流使用两个召唤位置。 它们拥有 [[S:DreamServant]]，受到的伤害降为 0；完成两次自身行动后逃跑。哆来咪死亡后，梦境敌人离场。
Doremy.en: Sleep and waking Sleep Barrier equals [[S:Sleep]] level ({Count2}) and replenishes at own turn end. Each [[0]] adds 50 current/max HP and one dream level. Actual damage wakes her early, except [[X:HeiseBijiben]] and [[J:QuickAct1]]. Waking clears sleep Barrier. Each awake defense adds 1 [[C:Nightmare]] to hand; attacks add it at dream level 1+. At level 2+, damage and Barrier improve. Sleeping all three times immediately starts Dream Master. Dream Master summons [[U:DreamRemilia]], [[U:DreamAya]], [[U:DreamJunko]], [[U:DreamYoumu]] are reshuffled every four summons, without repeats within a group, alternating two summon slots after an attack or defense. They have [[S:DreamServant]], reducing damage to 0, and escape after two own actions. They leave when Doremy dies.

DreamRemilia.zh: [[S:ScarletDestiny]]：每个玩家回合出牌达到 {Count2} 张时强制结束回合。[[S:DreamServant]] 将受到的伤害降为 0，行动两次后逃跑。
DreamRemilia.en: [[S:ScarletDestiny]] forcibly ends the player turn at {Count2} cards. [[S:DreamServant]] reduces received damage to 0; escapes after two actions.

DreamAya.zh:
[[S:FastAttack]]：主角每回合打出第一张牌时，受到一次 20 点攻击伤害。
[[S:DreamServant]] 将受到的伤害降为 0；行动两次后逃跑。
DreamAya.en:

[[S:DreamServant]] reduces received damage to 0; escape after two own actions.

DreamJunko.zh: [[S:JunkoPurify]] 为 1 层：每张牌纯化 1 点法力，最多单色优先。[[S:DreamServant]] 将受到的伤害降为 0，行动两次后逃跑。
DreamJunko.en: 1 [[S:JunkoPurify]]: purify 1 mana per card, prioritizing the largest single color. [[S:DreamServant]] reduces damage to 0; escapes after two actions.

[[S:DreamServant]] 将受到的伤害降为 0，行动两次后逃跑。

[[S:DreamServant]] reduces received damage to 0; escapes after two actions.

Siji.zh: 净颇梨审判 · 主角镜像 开战召唤与当前主角对应的镜像：[[U:Reimu]]、[[U:Marisa]]、[[U:Sakuya]]、[[U:Cirno]] 或 [[U:Koishi]]。 镜像具有 [[S:MirrorImage]]，使用对应角色 Boss 的行动。映姬被击败后，镜像继续战斗。
Siji.en: Pure Glass Judgment · Player mirror At battle start, summon the mirror matching the player: [[U:Reimu]], [[U:Marisa]], [[U:Sakuya]], [[U:Cirno]] or [[U:Koishi]]. The mirror has [[S:MirrorImage]] and uses that character’s boss moves. It continues fighting after Eiki dies.

Reimu.zh: 阴阳宝玉 [[4]] 在两个固定位置召唤 [[U:YinyangyuRedReimu]]、[[U:YinyangyuBlueReimu]]，各一只。 阴阳玉具有 [[S:Servant]]，灵梦被击败后会一同消失。红玉在自身回合结束增加火力；蓝玉增加灵力。 [[S:Fengyin]]：主角无法打出攻击牌。 [[S:Amulet]]：每层抵消一次新施加的负面状态，触发后消耗 1 层。
Reimu.en: Yin-Yang Orbs [[4]] fills two fixed slots with one [[U:YinyangyuRedReimu]] and one [[U:YinyangyuBlueReimu]]. The orbs have [[S:Servant]] and disappear when Reimu dies. Red gains Firepower at own turn end; blue gains Spirit. [[S:Fengyin]] prevents the player from playing Attack cards. Each [[S:Amulet]] stack cancels one newly applied negative status and is consumed.

YinyangyuRedReimu.zh:
由 [[U:Reimu]] 召唤，具有 [[S:Servant]]；灵梦死亡后会一同消失。
[[S:AbsorbPower]]：每次自身回合结束，获得 {Power} 点 [[S:Firepower]]。
YinyangyuRedReimu.en:
Summoned by [[U:Reimu]] with [[S:Servant]]; disappears when she dies.
[[S:AbsorbPower]] grants {Power} [[S:Firepower]] at each own turn end.

YinyangyuBlueReimu.zh:
由 [[U:Reimu]] 召唤，具有 [[S:Servant]]；灵梦死亡后会一同消失。
[[S:AbsorbSpirit]]：每次自身回合结束，获得 {Power} 点 [[S:Spirit]]。
YinyangyuBlueReimu.en:
Summoned by [[U:Reimu]] with [[S:Servant]]; disappears when she dies.
[[S:AbsorbSpirit]] grants {Power} [[S:Spirit]] at each own turn end.

Yuyuko.zh: [[4]] 在固定空位召唤 [[U:Wangling]]，具有 [[S:Servant]]。死蝶灵自己的掩护给予幽幽子 2 层闪避；第三次自身行动起，其攻击额外施加 1 层生者必灭。幽幽子缺少召唤物时会缩短召唤计时，但符卡仍优先。
Yuyuko.en: [[4]] fills fixed slots with [[U:Wangling]], with [[S:Servant]]. Their cover gives Yuyuko 2 Dodge; attacks add 1 Death stack from their third own action. Missing summons accelerate resummoning, while spells remain prioritized.

Cirno.zh: 四种协力 [[S:EnemyDayaojing]]：每次自身回合结束恢复 6 点生命，获得当回合跳过一次。 [[S:EnemyLarva]]：每次攻击实际对主角造成伤害时，施加 1 层 [[S:Poison]]；获得时向主角手牌加入 [[C:LarvaCure]]。 [[S:EnemyLily]]：[[0]] 由三段变四段；[[1]] 虚弱由一回合变两回合；[[2]] 冻结牌由两张变三张；[[3]] 冰甲 +3。 [[S:EnemyMaid]]：每次自身回合结束对主角造成 6 点效果伤害，获得当回合跳过一次。 四种协力不重复获得；每次新协力同时 +1 火力，集齐后使用 [[9,10]]，改为 +2 火力。L 开局协力在大妖精、莉莉、女仆中随机，之后才加入拉尔瓦。
Cirno.en: Four supports [[S:EnemyDayaojing]]: heal 6 at own turn end, skipping the acquisition turn. [[S:EnemyLarva]]: each actually damaging attack hit applies 1 [[S:Poison]]; acquisition adds [[C:LarvaCure]] to player hand. [[S:EnemyLily]]: [[0]] has four rather than three hits; [[1]] Weak lasts two rather than one turn; [[2]] adds three rather than two freeze cards; [[3]] gains +3 Frost Armor. [[S:EnemyMaid]]: 6 effect damage to the player at own turn end, skipping the acquisition turn. Supports are acquired without replacement; each gives +1 Firepower. After all four, [[9,10]] gives +2 Firepower. L’s opening support excludes Larva.

Koishi.zh: 五种灵感 [[1]]：获得 {Defend/2} + 符卡等级 ×2 点护盾。 [[2]]：向抽牌堆洗入 [[C:KoishiDiscard]]，符卡等级 0～1 时一张，2 级以上两张。 [[3]]：施加 [[S:Weak]]，符卡等级 0～2 时一回合，3 级以上两回合。 [[4]]：获得 [[S:Firepower]]，符卡等级 0～3 时一点，4 级以上两点。 [[5]]：获得 [[S:Graze]]，符卡等级 0～2 时一层，3 级以上两层。 灵感每次排除上一种。等级大于 0 时其意图隐藏，但当前非符卡攻击意图仍显示。[[9,10]] 每次提升一级；L 从 1 级开始。
Koishi.en: Five inspirations [[1]]: {Defend/2} + spell level ×2 Barrier. [[2]]: shuffle [[C:KoishiDiscard]] into draw: one at levels 0–1, two at 2+. [[3]]: [[S:Weak]] for one turn at levels 0–2, two at 3+. [[4]]: 1 [[S:Firepower]] at levels 0–3, 2 at 4+. [[5]]: 1 [[S:Graze]] at levels 0–2, 2 at 3+. Exclude the previous inspiration. Its intention is hidden above level 0; ordinary attack intentions remain visible. Each [[9,10]] raises the level, starting at 1 on L.

Junko.zh: 纯化耀光 · 计数与阶段 [[S:JunkoColor]] 累计本场战斗获得的彩色法力点数。 累计 0 点：等级 1；1～9 点：等级 2；10～39 点：等级 3；40～99 点：等级 4；100 点以上：等级 5。 每升一级，纯狐获得 {Power} 点火力。[[3]] 按等级施加负面状态：1 级施加两回合虚弱；2 级再加两回合脆弱；3 级以上再加两回合易伤。 [[S:JunkoLily]] 使法力纯化进一步造成对应层数的生命损失，不能用格挡或护盾阻挡。
Junko.en: Purified Light counter [[S:JunkoColor]] counts rainbow/Philosopher mana points gained in this battle. 0 points: level 1; 1–9: level 2; 10–39: level 3; 40–99: level 4; 100+: level 5. Each level gained gives Junko {Power} Firepower. [[3]] applies two-turn Weak at level 1, also Frail at level 2, and also Vulnerable at level 3+. [[S:JunkoLily]] makes purification additionally cost life equal to its stacks, bypassing Block and Barrier.

HardworkRabbit.zh: 模块安装优先级 1. 主角有闪避且未安装 [[S:AccuracyModule]]：安装精准模块。 2. 永久牌库不超过 20 张且未安装 [[S:LightingModule]]：安装光耀模块。 3. 未安装 [[S:PurifyModule]]：安装纯化模块。 4. 未安装光耀模块：安装光耀模块。 5. 未安装精准模块：安装精准模块。 6. 其余获得 {Power} 点火力。 精准模块使前两段攻击也精准，最后一段本来就精准。光耀模块在每次未闪避的命中后向抽牌堆加入一张 [[C:Xingguang]]；纯化模块在每次未闪避的命中后施加一层 [[S:TurnStartPurify]]。 [[S:InvincibleEternal]] 持续存在，受到的伤害不会超过 1。每套攻击完整完成后，这只月兔的基础伤害 +1。
HardworkRabbit.en: Module priorities 1. Player has Dodge and no [[S:AccuracyModule]]: install it. 2. Permanent deck has at most 20 cards and no [[S:LightingModule]]: install it. 3. No [[S:PurifyModule]]: install it. 4. No Lighting Module: install it. 5. No Accuracy Module: install it. 6. Otherwise gain {Power} Firepower. Accuracy also makes the first two hits accurate; the last already is. Lighting adds one [[C:Xingguang]] to draw per hit not dodged. Purify applies one [[S:TurnStartPurify]] per hit not dodged. [[S:InvincibleEternal]] caps each received damage at 1. Each completed attack sequence raises this rabbit’s base damage by 1.

LazyRabbit.zh:
[[S:EnemyTuanzi]] 每次自身回合结束恢复等于层数的生命，获得的当回合跳过。达到 {Count1} 层后，[[2]] 对该目标改为增加火力。
[[S:InvincibleEternal]] 使每次受到的伤害不超过 1。攻击基础值每完成一套 +1。有同伴时只在循环第一步偷懒，第二步仍会攻击。
LazyRabbit.en:
[[S:EnemyTuanzi]] heals its level at own turn end, skipping acquisition turn. At {Count1} stacks, [[2]] gives that target Firepower instead.
[[S:InvincibleEternal]] caps each damage at 1. Base damage rises by 1 per completed sequence. With the partner alive, only the cycle’s first step loafs; the second still attacks.

KanakoLimao.zh: 召唤池：[[U:ShenlingPurple]]、[[U:ShenlingWhite]]。首只颜色随机，随后交替；已有四个召唤物时不新增。召唤版本有 [[S:Servant]]，但没有神灵赠礼。首次召唤之后的召唤行动增加 {Power} 点火力，即使没有空位也会强化。
KanakoLimao.en: Pool: [[U:ShenlingPurple]], [[U:ShenlingWhite]]. First color random, then alternating, up to four. Summons have [[S:Servant]] but no spirit gifts. Summon moves after the first give {Power} Firepower even with no space.

SuwakoLimao.zh: [[S:SuwakoHex]]：每个玩家回合开始时，将一张不是青蛙的随机手牌变化为 [[C:Frog]]。[[2]] 的变化阶段另外从手牌、抽牌堆和弃牌堆选 {Count2} 张变化，只影响战斗卡牌，不改永久牌库。
SuwakoLimao.en: [[S:SuwakoHex]] transforms one random non-Frog hand card into [[C:Frog]] at each player-turn start. [[2]]’s transform phase separately changes {Count2} cards from hand/draw/discard, affecting battle cards rather than the permanent deck.

ShenlingPurple.zh:
自然出现的 [[S:ShenlingHp]]：被击败时主角获得 {Count1} 点最大生命。神奈子或挂坠召唤时不获得该赠礼；开局护盾与护身符仍保留。

[[S:Amulet]]：每层抵消一次新施加的负面状态，触发后消耗一层。
ShenlingPurple.en:
Natural [[S:ShenlingHp]] gives the player {Count1} max HP when defeated. Kanako/pendant summons have no gift, but retain opening Barrier and Amulet.

[[S:Amulet]]: each stack cancels one newly applied negative status, consuming a stack.

ShenlingWhite.zh:
自然出现的 [[S:ShenlingGold]]：被击败时额外掉落 {Count1..Count2} 枚金币。神奈子或挂坠召唤时不获得该赠礼；开局护盾与护身符仍保留。

[[S:Amulet]]：每层抵消一次新施加的负面状态，触发后消耗一层。
ShenlingWhite.en:
Natural [[S:ShenlingGold]] adds {Count1..Count2} money on defeat. Kanako/pendant summons have no gift, but retain opening Barrier and Amulet.

[[S:Amulet]]: each stack cancels one newly applied negative status, consuming a stack.

Sakuya.zh:
[[S:PrivateSquare]]：主角每累计打出 8 张其他牌，受到 5/5/10 点攻击伤害；计数跨回合保留。打出 [[C:SakuyaLock]] 时立即触发该伤害。
每次 [[4,5]] 使该效果的伤害增加 5。
Sakuya.en:
[[S:PrivateSquare]] attacks the player for 5/5/10 damage per 8 other cards used, carrying the count across turns. Using or playing [[C:SakuyaLock]] immediately triggers this attack.
Each [[4,5]] adds 5 to its damage.

Marisa.zh: [[S:FirepowerIsJustice]]：主角增加永久或暂得火力时，魔理沙会将自己对应火力补到至少同样数值；免疫 [[S:FirepowerNegative]] 和 [[S:TempFirepowerNegative]]。
Marisa.en: [[S:FirepowerIsJustice]]: when the player gains permanent or temporary Firepower, Marisa raises her corresponding Firepower to at least the same value. Immune to [[S:FirepowerNegative]] and [[S:TempFirepowerNegative]].

Long.zh: 耀光等级对应状态牌 [[0]] 加入弃牌堆：0 级 [[C:Xingguang]] ×2；1 级星光 + [[C:Xuanguang]]；2 级 [[C:Riguang]] + 眩光；3 级以上 [[C:Yueguang]] + 眩光 + 日光。 [[5]] 新闻组合：0 级 [[C:HatateNews]] ×2 + [[C:AyaNews]]；1 级文文新闻 ×2 + 花果子念报；2 级两种新闻各一张 + 当前主角特刊；3 级以上文文新闻 ×2 + 当前主角特刊。 每次 [[2,3]] 令 [[S:LongLight]] +1，并在手牌、抽牌堆、弃牌堆都没有 [[C:Bribery]] 时补充一张。
Long.en: Light-level cards [[0]] adds to discard: level 0, 2 [[C:Xingguang]]; level 1, Starlight + [[C:Xuanguang]]; level 2, [[C:Riguang]] + Glare; level 3+, [[C:Yueguang]] + Glare + Sunlight. [[5]] papers: level 0, 2 [[C:HatateNews]] + [[C:AyaNews]]; level 1, 2 Bunbunmaru + 1 Kakashi; level 2, one each + current character report; level 3+, 2 Bunbunmaru + report. Each [[2,3]] adds 1 [[S:LongLight]] and replenishes [[C:Bribery]] if absent from hand, draw and discard.

Remilia.zh:
[[S:ScarletDestiny]]：每个主角回合打出 {Count2} 张牌后，强制结束该回合。
[[8,9]] 每场战斗只触发一次。获得 [[S:Vampire]] 后，攻击造成实际生命伤害时，恢复等量生命。
Remilia.en:
[[S:ScarletDestiny]] forcibly ends the player turn after {Count2} cards.
[[8,9]] occurs once per battle. [[S:Vampire]] heals for the actual HP damage dealt by attacks.

Sanae.zh:
[[S:Curiosity]]：主角每打出一张能力牌，早苗获得 1/1/2 点 [[S:Firepower]]。
治疗间隔只在生命为一半或更少时缩短；符卡准备完毕时优先使用符卡。
[[S:Amulet]]：每层抵消一次新施加的负面状态，触发后消耗 1 层。
Sanae.en:
[[S:Curiosity]] gives Sanae 1/1/2 [[S:Firepower]] whenever the player uses or plays an Ability card.
The healing cooldown advances only at half HP or below; a ready spell takes priority.
Each [[S:Amulet]] stack cancels one newly applied negative status and is consumed.

LoveGirl.zh:
[[S:LoveGirlDamageReduce]]：每层减少 20% 受到的伤害，上限 100%。
打出 [[C:LoveLetter]] 获得 1 层 [[S:LoveGirlDamageIncrease]]，先抵消减伤层数。减伤全部抵消后，再打出情书会触发 [[2]]。
LoveGirl.en:
Each [[S:LoveGirlDamageReduce]] stack reduces received damage by 20%, up to 100%.
[[C:LoveLetter]] grants 1 [[S:LoveGirlDamageIncrease]], first cancelling reduction stacks. With none left, another Love Letter triggers [[2]].

YaTiangou.zh: [[S:FastAttack]]：主角每回合打出第一张牌时，受到一次等于该效果层数的攻击伤害。
YaTiangou.en: [[S:FastAttack]] attacks the player on the first card used each turn, dealing damage equal to its level.

RavenWen3.zh: 由 [[S:SihunYuSe]] 召唤，具有 [[S:Servant]]，没有闪避。
RavenWen3.en: Summoned by [[S:SihunYuSe]] with [[S:Servant]] and no Dodge.

RavenGuo3.zh: 由 [[S:SihunYuSe]] 召唤，具有 [[S:Servant]]，没有闪避。
RavenGuo3.en: Summoned by [[S:SihunYuSe]] with [[S:Servant]] and no Dodge.

Maoyu.zh: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]：第一次受到实际攻击伤害并存活后，获得等于层数的格挡，随后移除该效果。多段攻击整组结算后只触发一次。
Maoyu.en: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]: after surviving the first actually damaging attack sequence, gain Block equal to its level, then remove it. Multi-hits trigger only once after the sequence.

MaoyuRed.zh: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]：第一次受到实际攻击伤害并存活后，获得等于层数的格挡，随后移除该效果。多段攻击整组结算后只触发一次。
MaoyuRed.en: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]: after surviving the first actually damaging attack sequence, gain Block equal to its level, then remove it. Multi-hits trigger only once after the sequence.

MaoyuBlue.zh: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]：第一次受到实际攻击伤害并存活后，获得等于层数的格挡，随后移除该效果。多段攻击整组结算后只触发一次。
MaoyuBlue.en: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]: after surviving the first actually damaging attack sequence, gain Block equal to its level, then remove it. Multi-hits trigger only once after the sequence.

MaoyuBlack.zh: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]：第一次受到实际攻击伤害并存活后，获得等于层数的格挡，随后移除该效果。多段攻击整组结算后只触发一次。
MaoyuBlack.en: [[S:MaoyuBlock]]: after surviving the first actually damaging attack sequence, gain Block equal to its level, then remove it. Multi-hits trigger only once after the sequence.

SickGirl.zh: [[S:DeathVulnerable]]：死亡时，对主角施加 {Count1} 回合 [[S:Vulnerable]]。
SickGirl.en: [[S:DeathVulnerable]] applies {Count1}-turn [[S:Vulnerable]] to the player on death.

DollBlue.zh: [[S:DeathPoison]]：死亡时对主角施加等于当前层数的 [[S:Poison]]；[[2]] 会累加这份死亡中毒。
DollBlue.en: [[S:DeathPoison]]: on death, apply [[S:Poison]] equal to current stacks to the player. [[2]] increases these stacks.

DollPurple.zh: [[S:DeathPoison]]：死亡时对主角施加等于当前层数的 [[S:Poison]]；[[2]] 会累加这份死亡中毒。
DollPurple.en: [[S:DeathPoison]]: on death, apply [[S:Poison]] equal to current stacks to the player. [[2]] increases these stacks.

Yaoshi.zh:
[[S:RockHard]]、[[S:RockHardAura]]：受到攻击时，实际扣除的生命减少等于层数的数值，最低为 0。最后一只要石被击败后，移除其他敌人的庇护。
[[S:Electric]]：受到攻击伤害时，对攻击者造成等于层数的反应伤害。由格挡或护盾抵消的攻击伤害也会触发；多段攻击逐段触发。
Yaoshi.en:
[[S:RockHard]] and [[S:RockHardAura]] reduce HP damage from each attack by their level, to a minimum of 0. Defeating the last rock removes the aura from the other enemies.
[[S:Electric]] retaliates against the attacker for its level when receiving attack damage. Attack damage absorbed by Block or Barrier also triggers it; multi-hit attacks trigger separately.

YinyangyuRed.zh: [[S:AbsorbPower]]：每次自身回合结束获得 {Power} 点 [[S:Firepower]]。
YinyangyuRed.en: [[S:AbsorbPower]]: gain {Power} [[S:Firepower]] at each own turn end.

YinyangyuBlue.zh: [[S:AbsorbSpirit]]：每次自身回合结束获得 {Power} 点 [[S:Spirit]]。
YinyangyuBlue.en: [[S:AbsorbSpirit]]: gain {Power} [[S:Spirit]] at each own turn end.

Bat.zh: [[S:Vampire]]：实际造成未被阻挡的攻击伤害时，恢复相应生命；效果伤害不参与该回复。
Bat.en: [[S:Vampire]]: heal for actual unblocked attack damage dealt; effect damage does not count.

BatLord.zh: [[S:Vampire]]：实际造成未被阻挡的攻击伤害时，恢复相应生命；效果伤害不参与该回复。
BatLord.en: [[S:Vampire]]: heal for actual unblocked attack damage dealt; effect damage does not count.

LangTiangou.zh: [[S:PowerByDefense]]：主角在自己的回合使用防御牌时，狼天狗获得 {Power} 点 [[S:Firepower]]。
LangTiangou.en: [[S:PowerByDefense]]: when the player uses a Defense card during their turn, gain {Power} [[S:Firepower]].

Tianzi.zh: [[S:FlatPeach]] 每次实际受伤后恢复 {Count1} 点生命；[[S:EnemyEnergy]] 按实际受到的伤害累积，四舍五入。[[0]] 消耗 100 能量，[[1,2]] 获得天衣无缝且不消耗能量。
Tianzi.en: [[S:FlatPeach]] heals {Count1} after each actually damaging hit. [[S:EnemyEnergy]] gains actual damage received, rounded to the nearest integer. [[0]] spends 100 Energy; [[1,2]] grants Flawless without spending Energy.

FraudRabbit.zh: 击败诈骗兔后，收回它在本场战斗中收取的金币。打出 [[C:Payment]] 会让诈骗兔立即逃跑。诈骗兔死亡或使用 [[3]] 逃跑时，放逐剩余的转账。
FraudRabbit.en: Defeating the rabbit returns the money it billed during this battle. Playing [[C:Payment]] makes it escape immediately. Death or [[3]] exiles the remaining Payment.

Aya.zh: [[S:WindGirl]]：每次自身回合结束，将 [[S:Graze]] 补至 {Count1} 层。
Aya.en: [[S:WindGirl]] refills [[S:Graze]] to {Count1} at each own turn end.
